spans.note: V::empty_leaf/hash and LeafableHasher::two_to_one become the opaque HashSpec callbacks; the backing MerkleTree and BitPath are re-modelled locally (MTree, BitPath) rather than imported. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

SparseMerkleTree::new(height): builds the backing tree (which caches the zero-hash ladder) and an empty leaf map
spans.note: The empty-subtree root ladder built inside MerkleTree::new is modelled as the pure function zeroAt of the level; height+1 entries. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: Accessors: height, get_leaf (absent key returns V::empty_leaf), get_root, leaves, len, is_empty
spans.note: get_leaf cannot distinguish an unwritten key from a key explicitly set to the empty leaf; get_root reads the BitPath::default() slot and falls back to the cached ladder. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: SparseMerkleTree::update(index, leaf): update_leaf on the backing tree, then leaves.insert
spans.note: No bound on index is checked here or in update_leaf; the frame theorems and the out-of-range theorems are structural facts about which map slots move. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: SparseMerkleTree::prove(index): wraps MerkleTree::prove, sibling list bottom-up
spans.note: prove succeeds for absent keys and for out-of-range indices; on a fresh tree it returns exactly the cached ladder. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: SparseMerkleProof newtype over MerkleProof plus the dummy / get_root / verify / from_siblings delegations
spans.note: Every method here is a one-line delegation whose semantics lives in merkle_tree.rs; the local re-model implements the delegated fold and root comparison, and its agreement with the real MerkleProof is not proved. The verification theorems here are about the interface only: verification is a hash comparison and implies membership only under collision resistance, which constant_hash_forges_membership shows is genuinely required.

spans.label: Serialize / Deserialize impls for SparseMerkleProof (raw sibling vector)
spans.note: The serde wire format, its error handling and the length of the deserialized sibling vector are not modelled; a deserialized proof of the wrong length is not ruled out here.

spans.note: plonky2 CircuitBuilder gate emission is not modelled at all. Nothing in this module constrains an arbitrary in-circuit witness; the module covers only the native path.

boundaries.name: backing-merkle-tree-remodel
boundaries.obligation: MTree/BitPath/updateUp/proveLoop are a handwritten local re-model of the private MerkleTree and BitPath of src/utils/trees/merkle_tree.rs and src/utils/trees/bit_path.rs. That the re-model agrees with those files (and with the separate Zkp.Implementation.MerkleTrees module, which is deliberately not imported) is not proved.

boundaries.name: hash-collision-resistance
boundaries.obligation: The hash is an opaque callback. No theorem here says a verifying Merkle proof implies membership, that distinct leaf sets have distinct roots, or that a changed root implies a changed leaf. Those require collision resistance of the concrete Poseidon instance; constant_hash_forges_membership exhibits a callback under which they fail.

boundaries.name: leafable-trait
boundaries.obligation: V::empty_leaf(), Leafable::hash and LeafableHasher::two_to_one are modelled as arbitrary functions. No property of the concrete Bytes32/Poseidon instances (domain separation, non-triviality of the empty leaf, agreement between native and in-circuit hashing) is assumed or proved.

boundaries.name: u64-index-arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: Indices and BitPath::value are u64 in Rust and Nat here; the low-bit flip of BitPath::sibling is modelled arithmetically rather than as `value ^= 1`, and u64 wraparound of `1u64 << height` for large heights is not modelled.

boundaries.name: hashmap-order
boundaries.obligation: HashMap<u64, V> is modelled by an insert-or-replace association list. len, is_empty and lookup are faithful; iteration order (which determines the packed serialization order) is not.

boundaries.name: serde-roundtrip
boundaries.obligation: The Serialize/Deserialize impls are not modelled; nothing here rules out a deserialized SparseMerkleProof whose sibling count differs from the tree height, or a packed tree whose stored height disagrees with its entries.

boundaries.name: circuit-targets
boundaries.obligation: SparseMerkleProofTarget and the plonky2 CircuitBuilder lowering (new/constant/set_witness/get_root/verify/conditional_verify) are not modelled. No theorem here constrains an arbitrary satisfying in-circuit witness, and native/target agreement is not proved.

boundaries.name: panics-and-underflow
boundaries.obligation: MerkleTree::get_node_hash indexes zero_hashes[height - path.len()], which underflows for over-long paths; the model returns a default there instead of panicking. Rust panic and unwinding behaviour is not modelled.
